notes.title: Casino Update: Multiplayer Blackjack Is Live (Beta)
notes.notes:
The city just got a lot flashier. 💸

We’ve opened a brand-new Casino—complete with a refreshed surrounding area—and rolled out Multiplayer Blackjack (Beta) powered by a dedicated casino games server.


What’s inside

Multiplayer Blackjack (Beta): You’ll be auto-matched to a free table to play with other players.

Casino district refresh: The casino area has been refined/relocated for a smoother flow and better vibe.

Robust tracking: We’ve expanded casino event logging to keep games stable and fair.

Seamless payments: Bets and payouts run directly through your bank account for now (a chip-exchange machine is planned).


Good to know

Singleplayer Blackjack is temporarily disabled while we focus on multiplayer testing.

You’ll find the Casino on the right side of the city—it’s hard to miss.

The world map hasn’t been updated yet; that’s coming in an upcoming patch.

Help us test!

This is a beta—we need your hands at the tables. Jump in, play a few rounds, and share your feedback and bug reports.
Interested in helping? Join our Discord https://discord.gg/NynFRb5jdh

notes.title: PolyCrime v0.1.47 – Changelog

notes.title: PolyCrime Update v0.1.46
notes.notes:
PolyCrime Update v0.1.46 - Fixes, Saving & New Features

Greetings Crime Lords!

We're back with another update, version 0.1.46, bringing a round of important fixes, improvements to how your progress is saved, and a couple of new additions to the world.

Check out the full list of changes below:

[hr][/hr]

Fixes & Improvements

 Improved the SHOP loading process.
 Fixed collision issues with items held in hand.
 Resolved the item 'ghosting' bug where the placement preview wasn't visible.
 Updated the logic for attacks conducted via the darkweb.


Saving & Server

 Updated the logic for how attacks are saved to the server.
 Improved and expanded the system for saving player data variables.


Gameplay Features & World

 A computer has now been added to the motel room.
 Added a test version of the weapon dealer.


[hr][/hr]

notes.title: 🔥PolyCrime v0.1.39 – Changelog
notes.notes:
World & Environment



Adjusted global lighting and darkness density – nighttime atmosphere significantly improved.

Flashlight added – explore dark areas with ease.

Settings menu updated – groundwork for future FOV adjustment implemented.


NPC Behavior




NPCs now follow realistic daily routines – commuting to and from work based on in-game time and day.

Tutorial NPC behavior improved for better onboarding experience.



Police System


 Added additional police AI character models for visual variety.
 Police NPC spawn logic refined – improved distribution and responsiveness.


UI & Visuals


 Fixed duplicate UI calls that caused interface inconsistencies.
 Corrected buggy textures – graphical polish across multiple assets.
